T:P1.7.text: We operate in 37 states, partner with nearly 400 hospitals, and work with 4,300+ affiliated clinicians.

T:P1.8.text: We bring more than 45 years of experience to help hospitals respond to shifting demands with flexible, patient-centered care strategies.

T:P1.9.text: We invest in clinical services, operations, technology, and education—giving our clinicians the tools, resources, and support they need to deliver exceptional patient care.

C:P1.2.text: U.S. Physical Therapy offers ownership retention and business growth for PT clinic owners.

C:P1.3.text: U.S. Physical Therapy has Been Supporting Private Practice Partnerships

C:P1.4.text: Our partnerships thrive by growing the team and business identity they have already worked hard to cultivate. Our support teams are just that – support. From staffing to marketing, development, and operations, we work hard to realize your success. Together – we’re better.

C:P1.6.text: YOUR PARTNER IN A SAFE, HEALTHY WORKPLACE

C:P1.7.text: Our View on the Partnership Opportunity

C:P1.8.text: We’re looking to partner with physical and occupational therapy clinic owners with pride in their clinical outcomes and respect for their patients and staff. By choosing to partner with U.S. Physical Therapy, your brand will stay in place, we’ll purchase a percentage of your business, and you will retain an ownership stake in your clinics as we continue to grow together.

C:P1.9.text: U.S. Physical Therapy believes in the power of private practice.

C:P1.10.text: Through our partnership model, our community focused clinics provide pre- and post-operative care for a variety of orthopedic-related disorders and sports-related injuries, rehabilitation of injured workers and preventative care.

C:P2.1.text: Company Overview - USPh - U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc.

C:P2.2.text: U.S. Physical Therapy is one of the largest, pure-play operator of outpatient physical and occupational therapy clinics.

C:P2.4.text: U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. operates outpatient physical therapy clinics throughout the United States. The Company’s clinics provide preventative and post-operative care for a variety of orthopedic-related disorders and sports-related injuries, treatment for neurologically-related injuries, and rehabilitation of injured workers. In addition to owning and operating clinics, the Company manages multiple physical therapy facilities for unaffiliated third parties, including hospitals and physician groups.
